name: frontend-system-design-patterns
description: Runnable frontend system design pattern demos for I Code It

scripts.setup:log-analyzer: npm install --prefix log-analyzer/server && npm install --prefix log-analyzer/ui && npm run generate-logs --prefix log-analyzer/server
scripts.dev:log-analyzer: concurrently -n server,ui -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix log-analyzer/server" "npm run dev --prefix log-analyzer/ui"
scripts.typecheck:log-analyzer: npm run typecheck --prefix log-analyzer/server && npm run typecheck --prefix log-analyzer/ui
scripts.setup:streaming-ui: npm install --prefix streaming-ui/server && npm install --prefix streaming-ui/ui
scripts.dev:streaming-ui: concurrently -n server,ui -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix streaming-ui/server" "npm run dev --prefix streaming-ui/ui"
